column3: The feminine friends and neighbors are not distinguished by gender.
BSB’s “fill his belly” matches the Textus Receptus (κοιλίαν); the critical text has “to be fed” (χορτασθῆναι).
The request to be made like one of the hired servants is omitted; against you replaces before you.
“Returns” and “kill” render the past came and killed.
